question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.

Propel
Paddles are used to ________ the boat.
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: move
run
carry
rush
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: move

Propel - move

Explanation:
The word "propel" means to drive or push something forward, and "move" is the most appropriate synonym in this context as it conveys the action of causing the boat to go forward.
प्रोपेल का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को आगे बढ़ाना, और "मूव" इस संदर्भ में सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि यह नाव को आगे बढ़ाने की क्रिया को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
drive, push, thrust, impel, shove

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Propel – आगे बढ़ाना – To cause to move forward with force.
Example: "The engine's power helps propel the car forward."

run – दौड़ना – To move swiftly on foot.
Example: "He likes to run in the park every morning."

carry – ले जाना – To transport or support the weight of something.
Example: "She can carry two bags at once."

rush – जल्दी करना – To move or act with great haste.
Example: "They had to rush to catch the train."

move – हिलना/चलाना – To change position or cause something to change position.
Example: "Paddles are used to move the boat forward."

Conclusion:
"Move" is the best synonym for "propel" in this sentence because it accurately describes the action of pushing the boat forward using paddles, unlike the other options which do not fit the context.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Propitious

(MTS Non technical and Havaldar Examination 2021)
options: Inimical
Cogent
Conciliatory
Auspicious
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Auspicious

Propitious - Auspicious

Explanation:
"Propitious" means favorable or indicating a good chance of success, which aligns perfectly with "auspicious," meaning conducive to success or favorable.
"Propitious" का अर्थ है अनुकूल या सफलता की अच्छी संभावना, जो "auspicious" के अर्थ के साथ मेल खाता है, जिसका अर्थ है सफलता के लिए अनुकूल या शुभ।

Other synonyms Words:
Favorable, Promising, Advantageous, Beneficial, Encouraging

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Propitious – अनुकूल – (Favorable, indicating a good chance of success)
Example: "The dark clouds cleared, providing propitious weather for the outdoor event."

Inimical – शत्रुतापूर्ण – (Unfriendly, harmful)
Example: "The harsh weather was inimical to their plans for a picnic."

Cogent – प्रभावशाली – (Clear, logical, and convincing)
Example: "She presented a cogent argument in favor of the new policy."

Conciliatory – मिलाप करने वाला – (Intended to placate or reconcile)
Example: "His conciliatory tone helped ease the tension in the room."

Auspicious – शुभ – (Conducive to success, favorable)
Example: "The clear sky was an auspicious sign for their journey."

Conclusion:
"Auspicious" is the best synonym for "propitious" as both denote favorable conditions or signs of success. The other options either convey opposition ("inimical"), logical persuasion ("cogent"), or reconciliation ("conciliatory"), which do not match the meaning of "propitious."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Proposal
(CHSL Exam 2023 Tier I)
options: Scheme
Addition
Refusal
Filling
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Scheme

Proposal - Scheme

Explanation:
A "proposal" is a plan or suggestion put forward for consideration, and "scheme" is a synonym as it also refers to a systematic plan or arrangement.
प्रस्ताव एक योजना या सुझाव है जिसे विचार के लिए रखा जाता है, और "scheme" इसका समानार्थी है क्योंकि यह भी एक व्यवस्थित योजना या व्यवस्था को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Plan, Suggestion, Proposition, Offer, Initiative

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Proposal – प्रस्ताव – A formal suggestion or plan put forward for consideration.
Example: "The committee approved the proposal for a new park."

Addition – जोड़ – The action or process of adding something to something else.
Example: "The addition of a new chapter improved the book."

Refusal – इनकार – The act of refusing to accept or comply with something.
Example: "His refusal to cooperate delayed the project."

Filling – भराई – The action of putting something into a container or gap.
Example: "The dentist did a filling in my tooth."

Scheme – योजना – A large-scale systematic plan or arrangement.
Example: "The government launched a new housing scheme for the poor."

Conclusion:
"Scheme" is the best synonym for "proposal" as both refer to a structured plan or suggestion, while the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
Our teacher has proposed the project in a foreign university.
(Constable Safai Karamchari)
options: Accepted
Adopted
Declared
Suggested
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Suggested

Proposed - Suggested

Explanation:
The word "proposed" means to put forward an idea or plan for consideration. "Suggested" is the most appropriate synonym as it also means to offer an idea or plan for someone to consider.
प्रस्तावित शब्द का अर्थ है किसी विचार या योजना को विचार के लिए प्रस्तुत करना। "Suggested" सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी विचार या योजना को विचार के लिए पेश करना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Recommended, Advised, Offered, Presented, Put forward

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Proposed – प्रस्तावित – To put forward an idea or plan for consideration.
Example: "Our teacher has proposed the project in a foreign university."

Accepted – स्वीकृत – To agree to receive or take something offered.
Example: "The committee accepted his proposal after careful review."

Adopted – अपनाया – To take up or start to use something.
Example: "The school adopted a new teaching method."

Declared – घोषित – To announce something clearly and publicly.
Example: "The government declared a new policy on education."

Suggested – सुझाव दिया – To mention an idea or plan for someone to consider.
Example: "She suggested a different approach to solve the problem."

Conclusion:
"Suggested" is the best synonym for "proposed" because both words imply putting forward an idea or plan for consideration, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

He and his family members live in prosperity.


(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Richness
Loft
Poverty
Hardship
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Richness

Prosperity - Richness

Explanation:
"Prosperity" refers to a state of wealth, success, or good fortune, making "Richness" the most appropriate synonym.
समृद्धि का अर्थ धन, सफलता या अच्छी किस्मत की स्थिति है, जिससे "Richness" सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है।

Other synonyms Words:
Affluence, Wealth, Opulence, Abundance, Success

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Prosperity – समृद्धि – The state of being successful, especially in terms of wealth.
Example: "The country enjoyed years of economic prosperity."

Loft – अटारी – A room or space directly under the roof of a building.
Example: "He converted the loft into a small bedroom."

Poverty – गरीबी – The state of being extremely poor.
Example: "Millions of people live in poverty due to unemployment."

Hardship – कठिनाई – Severe suffering or privation.
Example: "The family faced financial hardship after the business failed."

Richness – धन-संपन्नता – The quality of having abundant wealth or resources.
Example: "The richness of the soil made farming highly productive."

Conclusion:
"Richness" is the best synonym for "prosperity" because both denote abundance and wealth, while the other options either mean the opposite (poverty, hardship) or are unrelated (loft).

Defend – बचाव करना – To resist an attack or protect from harm.
Example: "The soldiers defended their country bravely."

Example: "He slowly approached the frightened dog."

Attack – हमला करना – To act violently against someone or something.
Example: "The lion attacked its prey swiftly."

Conclusion:
"Defend" is the best synonym for "protect" because both words imply taking action to prevent harm. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

PROTEST (v.)
(MTS Non Technical 2020)
options: favour
object
support
assist
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: object

PROTEST - object

Explanation:
The word "protest" means to express strong disagreement or disapproval. "Object" is the correct synonym as it also means to express opposition or disapproval.
विरोध करने या असहमति व्यक्त करने का अर्थ है "protest"। "Object" सही पर्याय है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी विरोध या असहमति व्यक्त करना है।

oppose, resist, challenge, dissent, defy

PROTEST – विरोध करना – To express strong disagreement or disapproval.

favour – पक्ष लेना – To support or approve of something.
Example: "She decided to favour the new policy."

object – आपत्ति करना – To express opposition or disapproval.
Example: "He objected to the proposed changes in the meeting."

support – समर्थन करना – To agree with or help someone/something.
Example: "Many people support the idea of free education."

assist – सहायता करना – To help someone in doing something.
Example: "She assisted her friend in completing the project."

Conclusion:
"Object" is the most appropriate synonym for "protest" because both words convey the idea of expressing opposition or disagreement. The other options ("favour," "support," and "assist") imply agreement or help, which are opposite in meaning.

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Assemblage

rabble - Assemblage

The word "rabble" refers to a disorderly crowd or mob. "Assemblage" is the best synonym as it denotes a gathering or group of people, which fits the context of protestors coming together.
"Rabble" का अर्थ है अव्यवस्थित भीड़ या जनसमूह। "Assemblage" सबसे उपयुक्त पर्याय है क्योंकि यह लोगों के इकट्ठा होने को दर्शाता है, जो प्रदर्शनकारियों के एकत्र होने के संदर्भ में सही बैठता है।

Other synonyms Words:
crowd, mob, gathering, throng, multitude

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

rabble – अव्यवस्थित भीड़ – A disorderly crowd or mob.
Example: "The protestors formed a rabble outside the government building, demanding change."

Priest – पुजारी – A religious leader authorized to perform sacred rituals.
Example: "The priest conducted the wedding ceremony."

Quiet – शांत – Making little or no noise.
Example: "The library was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop."

Noisy – शोरगुल वाला – Making a lot of noise.
Example: "The children were too noisy during the class."

Assemblage – समूह / जमावड़ा – A gathering or collection of people or things.
Example: "The protestors formed an assemblage outside the government building, demanding change."

Conclusion:
"Assemblage" is the best synonym for "rabble" in this context because it accurately describes a group of people gathered together, fitting the sentence's meaning without any negative connotation. The other options either do not match the context or are unrelated.
